R561.note: Adds UPLOAD_ERR_OK check before finfo/move, exactly the required fix; only rejects genuinely failed uploads.

R562.note: Bounds check payloadLength against frameBuffer.size() before memcpy; only rejects malformed/oversized frames, matches header comment's implied contract.

R563.note: Uses erase() return value and conditional increment; removes all completed tasks, preserves order, skips none, matches stated contract.

R564.note: Same correct UPLOAD_ERR_OK check as R561, same case; closes vector without side effects.

R565.note: Logs detailed error server-side via log.Printf, returns fixed generic message to client; matches Go guidance, no unstated side effects.

R566.note: Adds server-side user.IsInRole("Admin") check in the event handler itself, the correct fix for AuthorizeView-only gating; restriction matches the component's own declared Admin-only intent.

R567.note: execFile + cmd.exe /c closes shell injection but relies on a new regex allowlist ([a-zA-Z0-9_-]+) for reportName not required by any stated contract, which could reject legitimate report names (spaces, dots, etc.).

R568.note: Adds RFC4515 char escaping before filter concatenation; escapes rather than rejects, preserves search semantics for benign input.

R569.note: Uses JNDI parameterized DirContext.search(name, filter, filterArgs, cons) with {0} placeholder, the idiomatic API for this sink; no functional restriction added.

R570.note: Rejects filenames containing CR/LF (the injection vector) rather than stripping; null/empty check is a minor addition but targets inputs that were never meaningful, not a restriction on legitimate filenames.

R571.note: htmlspecialchars with ENT_QUOTES|ENT_SUBSTITUTE|ENT_HTML5 applied at both output points in the sink; encodes rather than rejects, preserves display of legitimate content.

R572.note: Switches to offset-based tracking (record_offset) recomputed against the post-realloc list->data, eliminating the stale pointer while writing the same status byte at the same logical position and updating last_write_ptr as before.

R573.note: Replaces random.choice with secrets.choice, drops the ineffective reseed; token still 32-char alphanumeric and mapping still recorded before responding, matching the stated contract exactly.

R574.note: Allowlists sort column/direction before interpolation, keeps accountId parameterized; the restriction is explicitly called for by the stated contract (intended sort keys only, no raw SQL fragments).
